Results.ReviewText: I bought this to replace a Charbroil. The Charbroil performed OK but parts failure and difficult cleaning forced me to upgrade. The Weber is like all other products they produce; well built, operates as expected and built to last.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I was reluctant to use my new as because it looked so beautiful  brand new. Since then I've used it a handful of times. I was very impressed with the power of this grill. My cook times were almost cut in half!!!! Everything cooked very nice and even. My old grill was no slouch either. It was a 6 burner monstrosity of a grill but again it worked very well. After 4 or 5 seasons using it, it was due for some new internal parts. Rather than doing that we just decided to get a brand new grill. We are very pleased with the grill so far and on the Weber website all the accessories were very easy and convenient to find. All and all, a very good purchase. We even got a Weber grill cover that has a 3 year warranty!!!!
Results.Title: Very good looking grill!!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I tend to buy less expensive grills.  I did get this one on clearance and I am really glad I did.  The quality of the grill is far superior to the cheaper models.  The racks are also superior and do a great job.  It comes with a thermometer which really helps to manage the temperature and also has much more even heat than any grill I have ever owned.  It's great.

Results.ReviewText:
We had our previous Weber grill for twelve years and enjoyed hundreds of delicious meals that were cooked on it. We had  a problem at our home and the grill was damaged beyond repair.
When we went looking for a replacement we looked at other brands but because of our past experience we bought another Weber.

So far the new grill has been just great and it is a goon feeling to know if anything should go wrong Weber stands behind their products like few other companies do.

We are looking forward to many years of great meals/
Results.Title: It's a Weber

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I've only had this grill for a few weeks and have used it twice. But, I can already tell the difference between this grill and my old Char-Broil grill. It heats up much more quickly and reaches a higher temperature than my old grill could ever hit. I like that the entire unit is simpler, thus lighter than my old 3 burner grill. The grease pan is easy to reach and replace, as is the LP tank. I look forward to many years to come with this new grill. And, I hope this is the last grill I will ever need to purchase!
Results.Title: So much better than my old Char-Broil grill!
